name: Cable Single-Arm Decline Bench Press
steps: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back beside a low pulley with the handle at the side of your chest.
Press the handle above your lower chest without letting your trunk roll.
Bend your elbow and return the handle to the side of your chest.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep both shoulders in contact with the bench.
Brace your core to resist rotation and keep your wrist stacked over your elbow.
